description: This PHP class 'ContentPage' extends a base content page class and is responsible for generating HTML content pages, including embedding images as base64-encoded data URLs within the generated output.

classes.name: ContentPage
classes.description: Represents a content page that generates HTML content and embeds images as inline data URLs.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Overrides the base method to generate HTML content and embed images as base64-encoded PNGs.
